Package hadur2.core.shield

package hadur2.core.shield
Bullet shielding: noticing an enemy that shoots our bullets down, and aiming so it can't.

A bullet shielder (oog.mega.saguaro.Saguaro's BulletShieldMode, for one) sits still. Against a target that doesn't move, every gun, ours included, fires head-on at where the target was on the previous tick, so the shielder can work out our bullet's heading exactly and fire a weaker bullet to meet it mid-air. ShieldDetector spots this from how our bullets end (SHIELD-1); AimJitter then moves each shot's aim by an amount the shielder can't predict but that still lands on its body (SHIELD-2).

The package needs only plain Java: it keeps no randomness of its own (RES-6) and the same inputs always give the same offsets (CORE-2).

Neither class knows about bullets, waves or the gun: HadurCore feeds the detector our duel bullets' fates and adds the jitter to whatever angle the gun chose, so the counter works the same over either gun. The package imports nothing from the rest of the core; the architecture tests forbid it to depend on posture, and it is one of the duel packages DuelIdentityTest pins. See docs/bullet-shielding.md for how Saguaro shields and how the counter did on the bench.
